acceptance: The graph tool reports the exact missing dependency, self dependency or cycle chain, and its topological order breaks ties by id so repeated runs match.

positive.fixture: the real registry is closed and acyclic with a stable order

negative.fixture: missing dependencies and cycles are reported with exact ids and chain

security_and_source_permissions: Registry data carries no credentials; no real source app was observed, and source-account permissions stay outside the registry.
performance_memory_storage: Verification is linear in edges (2052 edges over 924 entries).
known_limitations: Dependencies are family-level anchors from policy; per-primitive refinement happens as primitives are specified
